slides.title: Speaking: conversation, photos and pair tasks
slides.subtitle: B1 speaking exam skills
goals: Keep a conversation going for 2–3 minutes.

head: Function
Phrases
rows: Both photos show… / In both pictures…
In the first photo…, whereas in the second…
It looks as if… / They might be…

head: Function
Phrases
rows: Shall we start with…? / What about…?
What do you think? / Do you agree?
OK, let's go for… / So we've decided on…

slides.title: Your turn
body: Find two photos of different holidays (beach vs city). Compare them aloud for one minute and say which you'd prefer. Record yourself.
list: ☐ Gave a preference with a reason
